data: Microsoft's fiscal 2025 ended June 30, 2025. Revenue was about $281.7 billion, up roughly 15% from $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024. Cost of revenue was about $87.8 billion, which left gross profit of about $193.9 billion and a gross margin of about 68.8%. Operating income was about $128.5 billion, an operating margin of about 45.6%. These figures are from my recollection of the company's 10-K, so please check them against the filing before relying on them.
